description: This file contains interface definitions, class and struct declarations, and serializer attributes for Orleans grain interfaces and related data types used in unit tests, including multiple serializer classes, grain interfaces, and data structures with serialization attributes.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Serializer class for command objects in namespaces One and Two, marked with GenerateSerializer attribute.

classes.name: Outsider
classes.description: Empty class marked with GenerateSerializer attribute, likely used as a data transfer object.

classes.name: CaseInsensitiveStringEquality
classes.description: Serializer class implementing case-insensitive string equality comparison.

classes.name: Mod5IntegerComparer
classes.description: Serializer class implementing integer equality comparison modulo 5.

classes.name: CaseInsensitiveStringComparer
classes.description: Serializer class implementing case-insensitive string comparison.

classes.name: RootType
classes.description: Data class with a dictionary of string to object, with custom equality and hash code implementations.

classes.name: SomeStruct
classes.description: Serializable struct with various fields, including private and readonly fields, and methods to access private data.

classes.name: SomeAbstractClass
classes.description: Abstract class implementing ISomeInterface, with various serializable fields, including enums, lists, and nested classes.

classes.name: AnotherConcreteClass
classes.description: Concrete implementation of SomeAbstractClass with additional string property.

classes.name: InnerType
classes.description: Serializable class with GUID and string properties, with custom equality.

classes.name: ClassWithStructConstraint
classes.description: Generic class constrained to value types (structs), with a serializable value.

classes.name: ClassWithNestedPrivateClassInListField
classes.description: Class containing a list of private nested class instances, demonstrating serialization limitations.

classes.name: ReadOnlyStructWithReadOnlyArray
classes.description: Readonly struct with a private readonly byte array, used as a regression test.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Overrides equality comparison for RootType, comparing internal dictionaries.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Overrides hash code generation for RootType.

methods.name: GetValueWithPrivateGetter
methods.description: Returns the value of a private property.

methods.name: GetPrivateValue
methods.description: Returns the value of a private field.

methods.name: SetPrivateValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a private field.

methods.name: SetValueWithPrivateSetter
methods.description: Sets the value of a property with a private setter.
